verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents scene-level revision for Video Agent videos: you name the scenes to revise, and untouched scenes keep their script and visuals. That covers regenerating one segment without redoing the rest, but only within Video Agent videos, and nothing shows whether the final output is re-rendered in full. missing for 10: any documented way to extend a clip, confirmation that the full video is not re-rendered, segment regeneration outside Video Agent videos, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video

citations.quote: Revise only the scenes you name in a Video Agent video
Untouched scenes keep script and visuals.
